title: Phase 58 opens the dated evidence queue with a bounded DARPA no-change receipt
summary: Ten held result and outcome gates now expose exact next artifacts and review dates. The first operating check retains the DARPA signal In Review because the reviewed canonical page does not publish the measured-results artifact required for promotion.
evidence_note: The negative decision is bounded to the canonical DARPA challenge page and official DARPA surfaces reviewed on August 11. It does not claim that results do not exist or will not be published.
prior_state: DARPA result signal In Review pending official measured results, winners, and prize decisions.
current_state: DARPA result signal remains In Review; source freshness advances to the August 11 canonical-page check.
publication_effect: Publishes one dated receipt and the ten-item queue without promoting, duplicating, correcting, archiving, or closing a signal.
